requiredFields.requestKind: walk or drive, emitted through the real gameplay UI/session command path
requiredFields.requestAccepted: true only after the session accepts the command
requiredFields.requestTransmitted: true only when the peer send_game_message succeeds; later server object-update position and displacement separately prove the server processed movement
requiredFields.originArea: server area at the initial controlled pose
requiredFields.originGeneration: world generation at the initial controlled pose
requiredFields.serverDisplacement: distance in world units between original and later server-authoritative controlled poses; must exceed 0.25
requiredFields.serverMovementObserved: true only after a fresh authoritative pose/snapshot, not a predicted local pose
requiredFields.speechEcho: true after a matching echo of the opt-in chat message
requiredFields.cameraFollowValid: true when the follow target is the moved controlled actor and camera state remains valid
requiredFields.presentationAnimationAdvanced: true only after ModelRigs diagnostic_sample/compare_samples witnesses changed controlled parts and either changed skin vertices or an active walk/run rigid clip with an advanced model clock
requiredFields.animationWitness: bounded before/after controlled actor model-rig sample comparison; contains changed_local_parts, advanced_model_clocks, maximum_local_skin_vertex_delta, skin_meshes_sampled, active_clips, activeWalkClip and rigidOnly
requiredFields.presentationFrames: at least two rendered actor rig pose-clock frames after command

graphicalFields.visualCapture: path to a PNG of the actual Godot world viewport after authoritative movement and animation witness, before clean shutdown
graphicalFields.screen: secondary monitor selected by the Godot/PowerShell matrix

acceptanceBoundary: The headless private Prelude movement/echo/camera/animation witness passes. The legacy join-local -Smoke mode still requires a graphical world frame from the same admitted area and exact caller-level acceptance before retirement.
